title: DEF CON 19 - Moxie Marlinspike - SSL And The Future Of Authenticity
summary: Moxie Marlinspike's DEF CON 19 talk on the weaknesses of SSL and the certificate authority system. He explains how CA trust became a problem and proposes an alternative that removes the CA oligopoly without reducing security.
why: HN points to it as the classic overview of why TLS certificate trust is flawed, and it resurfaces whenever CA or HTTPS security comes up.

quote.text: I've found Moxie Marlinspike's talk [1] to be a great overview of these sorts of issues.
